map.蓄积量扩展法：生物量 B=V×ρ×BEF（ρ 木材密度、BEF 生物量扩展因子）: Stock volume expansion method: biomass B = V×ρ×BEF (ρ wood density, BEF biomass expansion factor), carbon stock C = B×CF (carbon fraction about 0.5), CO₂ = C×3.667; total CO₂ = CO₂/ha × area, annual = total CO₂ / stand age, and value = total CO₂ × carbon price.
map.杉木（ρ=0.307,BEF=1.53,CF=0.52）蓄积 V=120 m³/: Chinese fir (ρ=0.307, BEF=1.53, CF=0.52) with stock V=120 m³/ha, area 10 ha, stand age 20 years and a carbon price of 60 CNY/t: B=56.4, C=29.3 t/ha, CO₂=107.5 t/ha; total CO₂ ≈ 1075 t, annual ≈ 53.7 t, value ≈ 64,500 CNY.

map.含碳率为何取 0.5？: Why take the carbon fraction as 0.5?
map.乔木木材含碳率多在 0.45~0.52，0.5 为常用均值；精确核算应采用树种实: The carbon fraction of tree wood usually falls between 0.45 and 0.52, so 0.5 is the common average. Precise accounting should use measured values per species, with the BEF covering the whole-plant biomass of branches, leaves and roots.
